Only scalar indexes are supported.
Write operations on the table are prohibited during index creation.
Creating an index on a table with a large amount of data consumes CPU and I/O resources of the instance. If instance availability is affected, call CancelCreateIndexJob to cancel the index creation

QueryKnowledgeBasesContent.description_zh: 用自然语句从多个指定文档库检索向量和元数据，合并多路召回结果后返回

RebalanceDBInstance.description_en: Rebalances an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
RebalanceDBInstance.description_zh: 对AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例进行部署平衡

ReleaseInstancePublicConnection.description_en: Releases the public endpoint of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
ReleaseInstancePublicConnection.description_zh: 释放AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版的外网地址

Rerank.description_en: The Rerank operation can resolve the issue of inaccurate ranking of vector and full-text search results. It re-scores and reranks the retrieved data through semantic understanding to significantly improve the relevance and accuracy of the results. AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL allows you to rerank search results by using Rerank models, but does not provide models
Rerank.description_zh:
Rerank能够解决向量检索和全文检索结果排序不精准的问题，通过语义理解对召回数据重新打分排序，显著提升结果的相关性与准确性。
AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL版支持调用Rerank模型对检索结果做重排，但不提供模型

ResetAccountPassword.description_en: Resets the password of a database account for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance

ResetSupabaseProjectPassword.description_en: Reset the password of a Supabase database

RestartDBInstance.description_en: Restarts an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance

RestoreSnapshot.description_en: Restores a Supabase project from a snapshot
RestoreSnapshot.description_zh: 从快照恢复 Supabase 项目

ResumeInstance.description_en: Resumes an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance

RevokeApiKey.description_en: Revokes the access permissions of an API key to SaaS services
RevokeApiKey.description_zh: 撤销API密钥对SaaS服务的访问权限

SetAsDefaultBranch.description_en: Sets the default branch for a Supabase project
SetAsDefaultBranch.description_zh: 设置 Supabase 默认分支

SetDBInstancePlanStatus.description_en: Enables or disables a plan for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
SetDBInstancePlanStatus.description_zh: 启用或禁用AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的计划

SetDataShareInstance.description_en: Add or remove an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance from data sharing
SetDataShareInstance.description_zh: 将AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例加入数据共享或从数据共享中移除

SwitchDBInstanceNetType.description_en: Switches between the internal and public endpoints of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
SwitchDBInstanceNetType.description_zh: 切换AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的内外网地址

TextEmbedding.description_en: Vectorizes text documents by using a model
TextEmbedding.description_zh: 通过模型对文本文档进行向量化

UnbindDBResourceGroupWithRole.description_en: Unbinds database roles from a resource group
UnbindDBResourceGroupWithRole.description_zh: 将资源组与数据库角色解绑

UnloadSampleData.description_en: Releases the sample dataset from an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
UnloadSampleData.description_zh: 释放AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版的样本数据集

UntagResources.description_en: Removes tags from AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances. If the tags that you remove are not added to other instances, the tags are automatically deleted
UntagResources.description_zh: 为指定的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例列表统一解绑标签。解绑后，如果该标签没有绑定其他任何实例，会被自动删除

UntagSupabaseProject.description_en: Unbinds tags from a Supabase instance
UntagSupabaseProject.description_zh: 解绑 Supabase 实例的标签

UpdateBranch.description_zh: 更新 Supabase 分支信息

UpdateCollectionDataMetadata.description_zh: 更新向量数据中的Metadata数据

UpdateDBInstancePlan.description_en: Modifies a plan for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
UpdateDBInstancePlan.description_zh: 修改AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版的定时计划

UpgradeDBInstance.description_en: Changes the specifications of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
UpgradeDBInstance.description_zh: 变更AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的规格

UpgradeDBVersion.description_en: Upgrades the minor version of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
UpgradeDBVersion.description_zh: 为指定AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例升级内核小版本

UpsertChunks.description_en: Splits a document into chunks and uploads the vectorized chunks to a document collection
UpsertChunks.description_zh: 将切分后的文档列表向量化并上传到文档库

UpsertCollectionData.description_en: Uploads vector data to a vector collection
UpsertCollectionData.description_zh: 上传向量数据到指定的向量集中

UpsertCollectionDataAsync.description_en: Uploads vector data in an asynchronous manner by using an on-premises file or a password-free Internet-accessible file URL. The vector data can be up to 200 MB in size
UpsertCollectionDataAsync.description_zh: 使用本地文件或公网可免密访问的文件链接异步上传向量数据，最大支持200MB
